title: Inference landscape: compact competitive vignettes & research sprint
creator: Aditi Shah
description: Objective: Produce a concise, buyer-centric series of 10–12 'vignettes' that illustrate realistic substitution scenarios (hosted ↔ dedicated ↔ private) across customer archetypes and regional constraints. Each vignette will pair empirical latency/cost evidence from our benchmarks with qualitative signals from customer interviews and competitor telemetry. Deliverables: 1) Vignette pack (10–12 one-page PDFs), 2) short synthesis deck with prioritized risk & opportunity map, 3) dashboard prototype for monitoring substitution signals, 4) tactical recommendations for developer docs and GTM messaging. Scope: narrow to LLM inference substitution points that matter for mid-market SaaS and platform teams (latency-critical chat, embeddings-heavy search, and regulated VPC/on‑prem use cases). Exclusions: deep model architecture analysis or open-research model internals — focus on operational decision points and procurement heuristics. Success metrics: stakeholder approval by Growth & Sales, 2 pilot customer interviews validated, inclusion of 3 actionable routing/placement recommendations in roadmap, and a lightweight monitoring alert spec added to Signal Hub.
